title: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 Suspension
description: On June 12, 2026, Anthropic suspended access to Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models worldwide following a US export-control directive citing security concerns and a jailbreak vulnerability. Earlier on June 9, Claude had launched Fable 5 as a Mythos-class model made safe for general use. Enterprise plans also gained admin permission management with custom roles on June 2.

community_feedback.quote: These models were incremental improvements, not doomsday devices
A very dangerous signal to the rest of the AI industry
Users expressed being pretty upset about the suspension

title: Session Folders and Integration Updates
description: Devin introduced Session Folders for organizing sessions into named folders via drag-and-drop. Added !ultra and !fast mid-session toggles for Slack integration. Released Devin Local agent version 2026.5.26 with new file awareness capabilities.

title: Bugbot Performance Improvements and SDK Updates
description: Cursor announced Bugbot is now 3x faster, 22% cheaper, and finds 10% more bugs per review. Average review time reduced from ~5 minutes to ~90 seconds. Introduced Design Mode improvements in browsers and canvases, new SDK functionality with custom tools and auto-review, and Organizations management for Enterprise customers.

community_feedback.quote: The latency between error detection and correction is collapsing to zero. Moving from code review to state verification
Game-changing features for automated PR reviews

title: May Releases (v1.120-v1.123) for VS Code
description: GitHub shipped versions v1.120 through v1.123 throughout May and early June 2026. Key features include Agents window in Stable (preview), remote agents support via SSH/Dev Tunnels, air-gapped BYOK models, expanded terminal output compression for tests and builds, and integrated browser with device emulation and screenshot capabilities.

title: Version v0.45.0 Stable Release
description: Released June 3, 2026. Updated default auto-routing and bypassed classifiers 5.0. Resolved critical issues including terminal interactions, Termux relaunch loops, and PTY resize errors. This stable release is recommended for most users.

community_feedback.quote: How is Gemini CLI still so far behind?
Terrible UI/UX experience and quality of responses being unusable
The team reads every piece of feedback and takes input very seriously
